feedback.end: This is a Celt. They lived in the UK during the Iron Age, which was over 2,000 years ago.

atoms.b: The Celts thought that nature was ((++holy scary)) and very important.
They were deeply connected to the land, and often worshipped rivers, forests and even the ((++sky dry)).
They believed in ((++many one)) gods and goddesses, who each represented parts of nature.

hint.label: Archaeologist
hint.text: An archaeologist is someone who looks at ancient sites and artefacts to learn about the past.

feedback.correct: Swords were given as gifts to the gods in the hopes it would bring soldiers luck in the battlefield.
The Celts worshipped the Sun and the Moon, which they believed were incredibly powerful.
Celts believed that animal bones contained part of the animal’s power, so wearing them worked like a lucky charm.
This charm belonged to a druid. They were the Celtic priests, but were also healers, educators and leaders in the community.

instruction.text: Read the description and select the correct Celtic festival.
instruction.sound: Read the description and select the correct Keltic festival.

atoms.a: During Lughnasadh, Celts thanked the god Lugh for the first harvest by making and sharing food.
Celts celebrated Samhain by lighting fires to keep away the dark of winter. This later became what we now call Halloween!
At Imbolc, Celts lit candles to welcome the first signs of spring. It was a time of hope and new beginnings.
Beltane marked the start of summer. Celts danced around a maypole and lit fires to ask the gods for sunshine.

instruction.text: Draw a line between Rome and Britain.

feedback.finish: In AD 43, the Romans came from mainland Europe to invade Britain.

atoms.b: We Romans came to Britain and brought lots of new ((++ideas deers)) with us, including stories of Jesus and his disciples.
Christianity wasn’t allowed in Rome because we had our own ((++gods dogs)) and goddesses, but it spread while we were in Britain, and later became the official religion.
Some Celts like me also began following this new ((++religion festival)), and several tribes even chose to convert!
atoms.sound: Some Kelts like me also began following this new religion, and several tribes even chose to convert!
